chunks: So adjudge between me and them conclusively, and save me and the believers who are with me.
ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet ask God for in Surah Al-Shu'ara regarding victory and salvation?
ai.summary: In Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a pivotal supplication by Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) seeking divine intervention to secure a decisive victory (fath) over the disbelievers and to deliver him and the accompanying believers from their oppression. Shia scholars often highlight this as a model for seeking spiritual and physical salvation through God's aid during times of trial, emphasizing the collective nature of the believers' deliverance.
